Interior Design Services at a Glance

AT Studio is an interior design studio based in Parkland, Florida, led by designer and construction engineer Anastasia Tolstenko. The studio offers full-service, new construction, remodelling, furnishing, developer and commercial interior design across South Florida, from Miami to West Palm Beach, plus online design for clients on the East Coast. Every project starts with a free meet & greet and a custom flat-fee proposal.

01

Full-Service Interior Design

Full-service interior design means one designer leads your home from the first concept to the final styled room. AT Studio handles design, material and furniture selections, procurement, vendor coordination and installation. We work on your budget, save you the time of communicating with every vendor and send you a written progress report every Friday – so you don’t need to be on site to know where your project stands.

Ideal forFamilies and couples · Homes $1M+ · Whole-home projects · Clients who want zero stress

What’s Included

  • Space planning and layouts
  • Concept, moodboards and 3D renderings
  • Materials, finishes and lighting
  • Kitchen and bathroom design
  • Furniture selection and procurement
  • Coordination with your architect, contractor and vendors
  • Installation and final styling
Timeline
Depends on scope
Your Involvement
Key approvals only + Friday reports
Starts With
Free meet & greet

What does a full-service interior designer do?

A full-service interior designer manages the entire interior: planning, design, selections, ordering, coordinating vendors and installing everything. You approve the key decisions – the designer handles the rest, from start to finish.

02

New Construction Interior Design

Interior design for new home construction works best when it starts early – ideally when the house is still a “box”. At that stage there is time to discuss, approve and finalize every design decision. As a construction engineer by training, Anastasia works alongside your architect and builder to plan layouts, kitchens, bathrooms, lighting and finishes before they are built – so changes happen on paper, not on site.

Ideal forFamilies building a custom home · Homes at shell or framing stage · Clients with their own architect and GC

What’s Included

  • Plan review and interior layout
  • Kitchen and bathroom design
  • Lighting and electrical layout
  • Finish selections: tile, flooring, plumbing fixtures, hardware
  • Cabinetry design
  • Site visits and contractor coordination
  • Furnishing plan for move-in
Timeline
1–3 years, follows the build
Your Involvement
Milestone approvals
Starts With
Plan review

When should I hire an interior designer for new build projects?

As early as possible – ideally when the structure is up, before electrical, plumbing and cabinetry are final. Bringing in an interior designer for new build work at this stage leaves time to discuss and approve the design without rework on site.

Home Renovation Interior Design & Remodeling

Home renovation interior design for kitchen, bathroom and whole-home remodels – with a construction engineer’s eye. We redesign the layout, specify every material and stay close to the contractor from demolition to the final finish. Our home redesign services cover everything from a new kitchen and bathrooms to a complete rethink of how the whole home flows.

How long does a home remodel with an interior designer take?

A typical remodel takes 3–6 months from design to completion, depending on scope, permits and the contractor’s schedule.

04

Interior Furnishing & Procurement

When construction is done but the house doesn’t feel like home yet, our home furnishing services complete it. We select furniture, lighting, rugs, window treatments, art and accessories, and our furniture procurement services take care of ordering, tracking and delivery with the showrooms and vendors we work with – then we install and style everything.

Procurement interior design work is where many projects lose time: dozens of vendors, lead times and deliveries. We coordinate every vendor so you don’t have to. Home decorating services – styling, accessories and art – are part of every furnishing project.

Ideal forNew move-ins · Finished builds and remodels · Second homes · Select projects outside Florida

What’s Included

  • Furniture layout plan
  • Furniture, lighting, rugs, window treatments and art
  • Styling and accessories
  • Procurement: ordering, tracking and delivery
  • Showroom and vendor coordination
  • Installation and final styling
Timeline
Based on vendor lead times
Your Involvement
One presentation + approvals
Starts With
Site visit

What does procurement in interior design include?

Procurement is ordering, tracking, receiving and installing everything in the design. The designer manages the vendors so every piece arrives correct and on time, and you don’t have to coordinate deliveries yourself.

05

Interior Design for Developers & Builders

AT Studio provides interior design for developers and builders working on luxury homes, typically in the $3–5M range. Developers know how to build – choosing and combining materials, finishes and interior details is our part. We define the interior concept and material palette that adds value to the property and deliver it on your construction schedule, including for homes that are already mid-construction.

Ideal forSpec homes · Luxury residential developments · Projects mid-construction

What’s Included

  • Interior design concept
  • Material and finish selections
  • Kitchen and bathroom design
  • Lighting and fixture selections
  • Drawings and specifications for your GC
  • Furnishing (optional)
Timeline
Follows your construction schedule
Your Involvement
Milestone approvals
Starts With
Plan review

Why do developers hire an interior designer?

Because material and design choices shape how a home is perceived and valued. A designer combines them into one coherent concept the builder can execute on schedule, so the developer can stay focused on construction.

A commercial interior designer plans the layout, selects finishes and furniture and coordinates the build-out of a business space, balancing brand, function and everyday use.

Interior Design Consultation

Every AT Studio project starts with a home interior design consultation – a free meet & greet at your home or by video. We look at the space, talk through your goals, timeline and scope, and recommend the right service. After the interior design consultation you receive a custom flat-fee proposal.

Ideal forStarting any project · Not sure which service fits · New build, remodel or furnishing

What’s Included

  • Discussion of goals, scope and timeline

What happens during a home interior design consultation?

We walk through your home or plans together, discuss what you want to achieve and how involved you want to be, and explain how we would work with your architect and contractor. Then we prepare a written proposal.

Interior Design Services FAQ

Getting started

01How does a project with AT Studio start?

With a free meet & greet – a home walkthrough or video call where we discuss your goals, timeline and scope. After it, you receive a written proposal with a flat fee.

02Do you work with clients who already have an architect or contractor?

Yes. Many clients hire their own architect and contractor and bring AT Studio in as the independent interior designer. We collaborate closely with your team throughout the project.

03Can you join a project that is already under construction?

Yes. We join new builds and developer homes mid-construction. The earlier we start, the more layout and finish decisions can still change without rework on site.

Cost & fees

04How do you charge for interior design services?

We charge a flat fee based on the scope of work, set out in a written proposal after the free meet & greet.

05Why don’t you charge per square foot?

A large bedroom and a small one often take the same design work. A flat fee by scope reflects the actual work, not the size of the room.

06Do you handle furniture ordering and delivery?

Yes. In full-service and furnishing projects we order, track and coordinate delivery with our showroom and vendor partners, then install and style everything.

Process & timeline

07How involved do I need to be during the project?

You approve key decisions – concept, materials, major purchases. We handle coordination and send a written update every Friday.

08Do I need to visit the site during construction?

Usually not. We work closely with the contractor and report progress every Friday, so many clients rarely need to visit.

09How long does a full-home interior design project take?

A remodel typically takes 3–6 months; new construction follows the build schedule, often 1–3 years. Furnishing depends on vendor lead times.

Areas & remote

10Which areas of Florida do you serve?

We serve South Florida from Miami to West Palm Beach, including Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. The studio is based in Parkland.

11Do you take projects outside Florida?

Yes – e-design and select furnishing projects in North Carolina, New York and along the East Coast.

12Do you speak languages other than English?

Yes, we work in English and Russian.
